messages:
alina: quick sync on PR #5175 1 — disconnected/install.md currently shows IP entries in /etc/hosts for KMS/HSM. QA flagged it as "looks required". can we standardize the wording to avoid confusion?
ben: short answer: prefer hostnames + TLS certs. IPs only as a documented bootstrap fallback for fully air-gapped sites.
chloe: agreed. propose: 1) show hostname-first example, 2) show /etc/hosts as 'bootstrap only', 3) include a secure curl example that validates certs (no --insecure).
dom: HSM note: PKCS11 config is vendor-specific. include a vendor-agnostic stub and call out that some HSMs have a separate mgmt NIC for admin traffic; remind people to allow that in firewall rules. also mention preferring env var for PINs, not inline secrets.
chloe: curl example suggestion:
```
# validate via explicit resolve and CA bundle (preferred fallback validation)
curl --resolve "kms.local:443:10.10.5.7" --cacert /etc/kms/ca.pem https://kms.local/healthz
```
ben: wording for certs i'd like: "Cert CN or SAN MUST match the hostname clients use. Prefer hostname-based certs. If using IP entries in /etc/hosts for bootstrap, include the IP in the cert SAN or avoid IP CNs."
alina: can we also add a tiny troubleshooting bullet about hairpin/NAT? common failure: control-plane or pod probes to internal IPs fail when SNAT prevents loopback. suggestion: recommend NAT loopback/hairpin on gateway or prefer hostname resolution to avoid SNAT edge-case.
dom: PKCS11 stub (to include in HSM appendix):
```
pkcs11:
  library: /usr/lib/libpkcs11-vendor.so   # vendor path
  token: "hsm-token-01"
  slot: 0  # verify with vendor tool
  pin_env: HSM_PIN  # use env var, not inline secret
```
dom: added note about HSM mgmt NIC and firewall rules as well.
qa-bot: linkcheck: two anchor mismatches in certs chapter reported; chloe pushed a commit that updates anchors in the disconnected guide.
build-bot: docs-ci: build succeeded for PR #5175 (:white_check_mark:)
alina: thanks all! i'll update the top-of-guide one-liner and the preflight checklist, then merge after a quick tidy. proposed changelog: "Disconnected install: clarified KMS/HSM addressing, cert CN/SAN rules, added PKCS#11 sample and hairpin NAT troubleshooting."

Preflight checklist to add in doc:
- DNS: prefer resolvable hostname for KMS/HSM; /etc/hosts allowed as bootstrap fallback
- Certs: CN/SAN must match hostname used by clients; prefer hostname-based certs
- HSM: configure PKCS#11 library path; verify slot/token with vendor tools; allow HSM management NIC in firewall rules
- Networking: enable NAT loopback/hairpin if control-plane sits behind SNAT (common probe failure mode)
